title: Variant handoff timer race caused cross-region bounce
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: During a regional capacity pressure event on 2026-02-28, several requests experienced repeated cross-region reroutes and degraded latency. The routing system repeatedly selected incompatible model variants (quantized vs. float) during fallback, causing transient decode errors and a reroute loop between region-primary and region-secondary nodes. This ticket captures the post-incident investigation, short-term mitigations, and long-term fixes to prevent timer/hand-off races in the smart routing stack.
root_cause: A race between the variant handoff TTL expiry and an asynchronous policy cache refresh allowed a stale policy weight to be used when selecting fallback variants. The stale policy directed traffic to a quantized model variant that was incompatible with the original request path (missing float decode path). When the downstream capacity signal cleared, the sticky route restored the original variant but the handoff timers had mismatched lifecycles, causing requests to oscillate between regions. Additionally, we lacked a compatibility invariant check that would have prevented assigning incompatible variants.
short_term_remediation: Revert the recent policy cache TTL reduction introduced in PR #8743 to restore conservative cache lifetimes (deployed 2026-02-28 10:05Z)
Temporarily pin routing to region-primary for in-flight sticky sessions (hotfix roll) to stop oscillation (rolled out 10:20Z)
Add an emergency invariant check in the router to reject variant assignments where variant_compatibility != request_compatibility (patch merged in PR #8761)
Raise alert threshold for variant-mismatch rate to 0.1% to catch regressions early
long_term_action_items: Make variant handoff and policy cache updates atomic: introduce a transaction around policy refresh + handoff TTL update (owner: routing-team, ETA: 3 sprints)
Add e2e chaos tests that simulate policy refresh races and region failovers in CI (owner: infra-qa, ETA: 2 sprints)
Implement variant compatibility metadata and enforce at the policy evaluation layer (owner: model-onboarding, ETA: 4 sprints)
Improve telemetry: emit variant-selection trace for every routed request and build a daily dashboard showing mismatches and oscillation patterns (owner: observability, ETA: 2 sprints)
Policy authoring guardrails: add linter that flags policies which can produce incompatible fallbacks (owner: control-plane, ETA: 1 sprint)
Introduce a conservative backoff mechanism before reassigning sticky routes after capacity signals clear (owner: serving-runtime, ETA: 3 sprints)
verification_steps: Synthetic replay of the exact request distribution that triggered the incident using the routing simulator (must show no reroute oscillation)
Run CI chaos test that toggles policy cache TTLs while incrementally failing and restoring regional capacity
Monitor production variant-mismatch metric for 7 days after release: target < 0.01% and no multi-region reroute traces
Post-release runbook walkthrough with oncall to validate emergency pin and roll-forward procedures
